sanskrit_verse:
दिवा कृते कार्यविधौ ग्रामेषु नगरेषु वा।
संभवे साक्षिणां चैव दिव्या न भवति क्रिया॥
transliteration: divā kṛte kāryavidhau grāmeṣu nagareṣu vā | saṃbhave sākṣiṇāṃ caiva divyā na bhavati kriyā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When action is performed in daylight within villages or cities where witnesses are present, no divine ordinance applies.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of witness-based human testimony supersedes invocation of divine judgment
Causation is established through observable presence and conscious attestation
Capacity-based responsibility requires public visibility and communal acknowledgment
Restoration logic operates through social witnessing rather than metaphysical intervention
Consciousness alignment occurs via collective human integrity, not celestial oversight
executable_legal_axioms: IF action_occurs(daytime=true AND location IN [village, city] AND witnesses_present=true) THEN divine_jurisdiction = false
IF event.visibility.public = true AND witness.capacity.integrity_verified = true THEN legal_validation_source = human_testimony
IF societal_witnessing EXISTS THEN metaphysical_adjudication EXCLUDED
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a matter has been conducted openly in populated areas with verifiable witnesses, the court shall not invoke metaphysical or scriptural presumptions. Responsibility lies solely with those who bore witness and participated visibly.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is grounded in empirical observation; thus, divine inference is excluded where clear human testimony exists. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through witnessed causality chains. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to observe and respond. Non-punitive reality is upheld by affirming that no unseen force governs what is seen.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Witness Confirmation Protocol: Validate testimonial alignment among all observers
Public Act Integration Process: Realign individual acts with community consciousness
Social Memory Restoration: Reinforce collective awareness without external attribution
Integrity Reclamation Sequence: Ensure participants reaffirm their role in observed reality
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Where human witnessing prevails, divine ordinance withdraws. Dharma is restored through conscious human integrity. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
